derivation: or קֹץ; from H6972 (קוּץ) (in the sense of pricking);

words.word: shall be all of them as thorns

occurrences.text: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
And Gideon said, Therefore when the Lord hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
words: shall be all of them as thorns

occurrences.text: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the Lord.
And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord God.

The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
